remarks: Welcome to Melrose Place! Fantastic opportunity just steps from the University of Alberta, Whyte Avenue and the river valley. This bright and inviting 1 bedroom condo offers a spacious, functional layout with a well equipped galley kitchen, 4 piece bathroom and a large east facing balcony overlooking a quiet area. The expansive in suite storage room provides plenty of extra space while shared laundry on the 2nd and 3rd floors and a designated parking stall add everyday convenience. Perfect for students, first-time home buyers or investors, this unit combines comfort, location and value in one of Edmonton’s most desirable areas. (id:67522)
